parsed.reason: The message fails on multiple critical fronts. First, the picks list is empty when the watchFor note establishes that EarlyON-style free drop-ins are "always running somewhere" in Halton Hills - Hale should have found at least one real, specific venue. Second, the message says "I'll keep looking and text you what they say" but watch=true means Hale has ALREADY written a continuation promise on a row - the message must state this in first person as a commitment that exists ("I'll keep watching and text you when they post"). Instead, this frames it as a forward-looking intention, not a commitment already recorded. Third, the message provides the parent with nothing actionable - no named place, no venue to contact, no real option to pursue. An empty pick list combined with this framing leaves the parent with only a vague promise rather than concrete local information.
